scope: E33-A only, frozen E24 C seeds17/29, development trajectories only, layers1/15/29 head0 all chunk2/5/8 step0/2 two tiles:72 events per seed. No new QKV, network training, Reader reuse, Test, production inference edits or B stage.

methods.A1: fixed KV representatives, optimize four positive normalized weights
methods.A2: fixed equal weights and Value representatives, optimize four Keys only, same4x128 Key capacity

support: All SHA+ordered-token verified repeated historical pages in selected groups. Unsupported history and all current pages unchanged. No current-event labels in fit. tile donors same chunk/step different tile; step donors same chunk different step; forward donors strictly earlier chunk. Also evaluate matched tile/step on intersection of three supports.
objective: Uniform per donor event and per Query logZ squared error, neither recipient mass nor recipient labels. Adam200 updates; A1 lr0.05 with1e-6 centered weight-logit squared regularization; A2 lr0.02 normalized Key offsets with1e-4 offset squared regularization. Key scale fixed from donor raw within-group deviations RMS. Best regularized donor objective per page, no heldout tuning, single start at C summary. This is a finite optimization diagnostic, not global R4 capacity proof.
precision: FP64 fitting; evaluation uses BF16 rounded new Keys or positive weights, rounded weights renormalized to sum1. Value reconstruction unchanged. Retain donor loss before/after and quantization error.
routing: Same fixed theta and Risk formula; weighted logits used identically in N/Z and Risk group probabilities. A2 refreshes stats slot8 = norm(raw subgroup mean-new key), other stats unchanged. No prediction using old Reader against new summary. Recompute new Risk mask, Medium and all Q64 true swap labels.
evaluation: Heldout logZ MAE/RMSE and exp quality error, same-mask and rerouted mixed NMSE, V/Z/cross energy decomposition on actual unselected set, new Medium true Oracle gain/no-op. Report coverage and matched-support controls, absolute gains not only Oracle recovery.
screening: For a method to support B followup: both model seeds on strict-forward covered events reduce heldout covered-page logZ RMSE >=10%, rerouted pooled NMSE <=102% baseline, neither trajectory worsens pooled NMSE >2%; additionally tile and step quality RMSE improve and pooled mixed NMSE <=102% baseline. No automatic B training this turn; describe limited forward coverage and optimizer limitations. No hyperparameter or capacity sweep.
